pages.text: A Mindspindle is an Arcane Gem formed from a green-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in a pampel cut.$(br2)When held, a Mindspindle magnifies the amount of experience contained within experience globes by 50%. It loses one point of charge for each experience point amplified, and can affect an

un-amplified total of 800xp before needing to be recharged.$(br2)If you come into contact with a very large number of experience globes while holding a Mindspindle, you can absorb their essence instantly, instead of needing to wait for each globe to be picked up in sequence.$(br2)To recharge a dun Mindspindle, activate the gem while you have a book in your inventory. The book is consumed.
